title: Long full-data IBM-OM HWA with a matched exact-master P&V handoff
hypothesis: Ten full MNIST epochs of hardware-aware teacher-KL training will improve deployment of the fixed-final master when every arm uses the same fault-blind exact-master P&V request. Stochastic apparent-noise HWA will be called beneficial over deterministic HWA, and each HWA method beneficial over no HWA, only if pooled fresh-array apparent accuracy improves by at least 1.0 percentage point, at least two of the three fresh-array assignment means improve, and no fresh-array mean becomes more than 2.0 points worse. Decisions are separate for counterfactually repaired and published-stuck-cell populations.
motivation: The preceding 4,096-example diagnostic used 1,280 optimization steps and showed that AIHWKit-equation apparent-noise injection improved published-defect fresh-target accuracy over deterministic HWA, but not over the exact no-HWA arm. That comparison still gave HWA a target-specific support clamp while no HWA requested the exact FP32 master. This follow-up increases training to 55,000 examples for ten epochs (34,380 steps), records the fixed-final learning curve, and makes no-HWA, deterministic-HWA, and stochastic-HWA deployments request their exact fixed-final masters from the same P&V controller. It also tests the user's expectation correctly: arrays A-D are independent draws from one device distribution, not numerically identical realizations.

arms.description: Repaired-device no-update exact-master P&V baseline on source A and fresh B-D.
Repaired-device ten-full-epoch deterministic support-forward HWA with exact-master P&V.
Repaired-device ten-full-epoch stochastic apparent-write-noise HWA with exact-master P&V.
Published-stuck-cell no-update exact-master P&V baseline on source A and fresh B-D.
Published-stuck-cell ten-full-epoch deterministic support-forward HWA with exact-master P&V.
Published-stuck-cell ten-full-epoch stochastic apparent-write-noise HWA with exact-master P&V.

completion_criteria: All six declared configs complete exactly once on the 784-50-10 analog-MVM--digital-ReLU--analog-MVM network. Every arm uses source assignment A=87004 with endpoint streams 89402-89405 and fresh arrays B=87005, C=87006, and D=87007 with four endpoint streams each; all headline accuracies use the same first 1000 official MNIST test examples.

Within each no-HWA/deterministic/stochastic role, repaired and published configs differ only in device.corruption_policy. Across roles, teacher, architecture, mapping, controller, assignments, endpoint streams, runtime/data seeds, P&V pulse cap and tolerance, and evaluation cohorts are identical.

Every deployment requests the exact FP32 master: the unchanged teacher in no HWA and the exact fixed-final master after HWA. P&V receives no support, stuck mask, stuck value, or eligibility mask. Per-array support projection is reported only as a diagnostic and never substitutes for the requested target.

Each trained arm uses all 55000 held-in MNIST examples, batch size 16, 3438 minibatches per epoch, ten fixed-final epochs, exactly 34380 Adam steps, teacher-KL, logical rates [0.0001,0.0001], betas [0.9,0.999], epsilon 1e-8, and no checkpoint selection. Initial and every epoch's deterministic realized-state accuracy are recorded on exactly 1000 validation and 1000 test examples.

Deterministic HWA forwards through clamp(master, source-A support). Stochastic HWA forwards through q_apparent=clamp(master, source-A support)+1.4113*0.0949*N(0,1), using one replayable full-array draw per minibatch, identity STE, and configured seed 88042. This is AIHWKit 1.1 OM write-noise equation/distribution parity, not native C++ RNG-stream parity, full compact programmed-endpoint sampling, or per-minibatch resampling of device identities and stuck masks.

Every source and fresh-array assignment reports exact requested master, support-mapped and deterministic-codebook diagnostics, four post-P&V apparent-forward and persistent-q accuracies, defect counts, saturation/exhaustion, pulse/read totals, prediction hashes, state hashes, and target mapping rule. The exact-master target hash is common across A-D within each arm.

Population receipts prove A-D use independent assignment seeds but the same preset and sampling policy. No-HWA differences across A-D are treated as finite realized device/defect/P&V variation, not as different logical models. Four endpoint streams on one assignment remain repeated writes, not four independent arrays.

The study remains an AIHWKit-preset, first-1000-example diagnostic. It makes no fabricated-device, fresh-read, retention, drift, endurance, line-resistance, peripheral, native-WeightModifier, or on-chip-learning claim.
analysis_plan: Verify all artifacts, config hashes, executable-source identity, paired population masks, teacher/master hashes, 34380-step counts, stochastic RNG receipts, exact-master target hashes, and P&V accounting before comparing accuracy.

First report the no-HWA array means A, B, C, and D. State that equivalence means exchangeability under the sampled device distribution; it does not imply identical accuracies for four independently sampled arrays. Report repaired and published between-array range and defect counts.

For repaired and published populations separately, compare no HWA, long deterministic HWA, and long stochastic HWA on source A and on each fresh target B-D. Apparent post-P&V accuracy is primary; persistent q remains a programming-state diagnostic.

Use B-D assignment means as the fresh-array statistical units and pooled twelve-write accuracy only as a secondary programming-outcome summary. Apply the predeclared +1-point, two-of-three, and no-worse-than-2-point conjunction separately to stochastic versus deterministic, deterministic versus no HWA, and stochastic versus no HWA.

Inspect the ten-epoch deterministic realized-state test curves and KL curves for convergence or late degradation. Because selection is fixed-final, do not replace epoch ten post hoc; a later epoch or learning-rate choice requires a new predeclared study.

Decompose any remaining HWA transfer failure into source-A adaptation, A-to-B/C/D mismatch, and P&V realization. If stochastic HWA improves source/noisy diagnostics but not fresh-array deployment, identify the unmodeled intervention: per-minibatch identity/defect-map and acceptance-conditioned endpoint resampling.
Compare against the prior 1280-step exact/support-handoff diagnostic only descriptively. Do not pool its optimizer budget or support-clamped deployment results with this exact-master study.
